# Pitlane 0.5.7

Clearer mission conversations and a fix for interrupted Codex missions.

- After your first message, keep a private conversation with Maestro alongside a shared mission group with agent updates and review results.
- Send instructions privately to Maestro while following the team's progress in the group. The initial mission screen stays the same.
- Use **Show thinking** to reveal activity summaries and execution details. This is a display control only; it does not change model reasoning.
- See the model reported by each agent and reviewer, including restored history. When no model has been reported, Pitlane says so.
- Fix missions stopping with **Codex event belongs to a different turn** when Codex creates an internal agent during a task or review.
- Keep communication responsive when instructions and agent output arrive together, while preserving cancellation and approval boundaries.
- Render agent activity details only when you choose to show them, reducing unnecessary work during busy missions.

Windows x64. Existing failed missions can be resumed with **Retry mission**. Installation on a clean Windows system and an update through the installed updater are not part of the validation reported for this release.
